entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return an order.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and the email address you used for the order?

Thank you, Alex. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered back on December 15th. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not broken. I just changed my mind.
I see. So it's just not the right fit for you?
Look, it was an impulse buy. I just don't use it. I want to send it back.
I understand completely. Thank you for clarifying that for me. Let me just check the return eligibility on this item... one moment, please.

Okay, Alex, thank you for your patience. I've reviewed your order details, and since it was delivered on December 15th, you are still well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you.
Oh. Fine. What do I do?
I am generating a prepaid shipping label for you right now. I'll be sending that to the email we have on file, a.chen@email.com. Is that correct?

Great. You should see that email in the next five minutes. Just print the label, attach it to the box with the VeloBand inside, and drop it off at your local post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Does that sound good?
It's on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Alex?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
